text:
Jenna (Design): Quick design review — new Create API token modal in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/create-token. Main asks: warning hierarchy, keyboard order, and the ephemeral copy flow. Thoughts? Luis (Eng): Looks neat. One immediate nit: the warning banner contrast in dark mode is pretty low on the icon background — likely fails AA. Sam (A11y): Agree on contrast. Also need explicit SR announcements when the secret is shown after create. Focus should move into the secret container and we should announce it. Example snippet: ```html
Your new token is shown below. Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
``` Ava (PM): We also want clearer defaults: org tokens default expire 90 days, dev tokens 30 days. Label the expiry field like: "Expires in (default 90 days)" so it's explicit. Maya (Security): The scopes UI needs a stronger least-privilege nudge. When someone selects any admin.* scope, show a secondary inline warning: "Admin scopes grant full project access — review before granting." Kevin (Frontend): Small accessibility implementation note: put the "Show secret" toggle before the copy button in DOM order so screen readers encounter it naturally. Also ensure opening the preview link doesn't trap focus in the modal. Noa (QA): Quick keyboard repro: open modal -> Tab sequence currently: Name -> Scopes -> Create -> (skips expiry) -> CTA. We should enforce linear tab order: Name -> Scopes -> Expiry -> Show secret toggle -> Copy -> Create. I'll add exact steps to the ticket. Jenna (Design): Re: empty state for tokens — proposal copy: "You don't have any API tokens yet. Create one to start using the API." Primary CTA: "Create API token". Make sure the empty state has a single H1 and is announced on navigate. Luis (Eng): Backend check: when a token is created with elevated scopes, return header `X-Token-Visibility: limited` and emit audit event `token.created.admin` so security can monitor. Ava (PM): Undo flow for revoke: we'll show a snackbar: "Token revoked. Undo" for 10s. Accessibility: mark it with `aria-live=\"assertive\"` and ensure keyboard focus is not stolen. Copy for snackbar: exactly "Token revoked. Undo". Sam (A11y): For the revoke confirm dialog: ensure `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\"` and ESC closes. Add a visual and text cue beyond color for the irreversible action: icon + text: "Irreversible: this will stop all apps using this token." Maya (Security): For org-level tokens, add an extra checkbox in the revoke flow: "I understand revoking this token will affect services and integrations." Required to enable Revoke button. Kevin (Frontend): UI contrast nit: the small ghost "Copy" button in the token row is currently ~2.6:1 on the gray bg. Need >= 3:1 for AA large text; bump weight or change bg. Also avoid relying solely on color for the scope chips — add a subtle icon when high privilege is selected. Noa (QA): I'll add test cases: VoiceOver + NVDA token creation path, keyboard-only flow, and revoke undo timing. Will include a1: focus order assertions. Ava (PM): Great. Jenna, can you update the Figma with: contrast and icon variants, new tab order notes, explicit expiry labels, and the extra checkbox for org revokes? I'll create tickets for analytics events: `token.create`, `token.copy`, `token.revoke`, `token.rotate`. Jenna (Design): Will update Figma and drop comments on the nodes. New Figma link with comments: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/create-token?node-id=42:7 — comments pinned to the modal and empty state. Tagging @Luis @Kevin when done. Thanks! :thumbsup: archi-bot: Preview environment created for the modal branch: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/287/token-modal-preview (use for QA).
